findings.passage: Implementing a Voter ID requirement is critical in securing our elections. This initiative reinstates trust in our democracy and ensures every legal vote is counted.
findings.note: Statement attributed to him on the Reform California page about the filing of the California Voter ID initiative. Page date as shown on the page.

findings.passage: This initiative bypasses the corrupt politicians and puts this directly in the hands of voters. We’ve drafted it carefully. It’s constitutional. And we’re going to win this fight.
findings.note: Quoted on the Reform California page about the filing of the initiative with the Secretary of State. He is named as one of the filers. Page date as shown on the page.

findings.motion: Co-filer of the California Voter ID Initiative with the Secretary of State
findings.note: The page says he, with two others, filed the California Voter ID Initiative, which starts the 75-day period to collect 1 million signatures.

findings.motion: Senate floor: AB 1116 passed Assembly third reading in the Senate
findings.note: AB 1116 (Berman), voter registration, would let people register online without a California driver license or state ID by giving the last four digits of their Social Security number. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy. He voted no.
subjects: voter registration without a state ID
